subject: Extensive online list of distance sampling references -- new URL

messages.author: 5900eadecec2d82d
messages.subject: Extensive online list of distance sampling references -- new URL
parts:
Distance sampling folks. For a few years now, Tiago Marques has been
building an extensive and searchable list of distance sampling
references online, on his web site. This valuable page has now moved
location, so update your bookmarks. The new address is:

http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distancesamplingreferences/

Tiago welcomes suggestions for additional papers to add to the list -
his email address is at the bottom of the page.

Cheers,

- Len Thomas

--
Len Thomas, Co-ordinator, Distance Development Project
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Centre for Research into Environmental and Ecological Modelling
The Observatory, University of St Andrews, Scotland KY16 9LZ

email: dist...@mcs.st-and.ac.uk
